The Club

Built in Kasangati. Playing for Uganda's top flight.

Kiyinda Boys FC is a FUFA Big League club from Wampeewo, Kasangati in Wakiso District. We play our home matches at Bertham City Stadium in Kiwenda, in front of a community that has backed this club from the start. Our aim is simple: develop local talent and take Kiyinda into the Uganda Premier League.

Home Bertham City Stadium
Based Kasangati, Wakiso
League FUFA Big League
